module_summary: Six-state Moore FSM: a 3-bit state register advances on input w via a combinational next-state case, and z decodes states E/F.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit Moore state register (A-F), synchronous reset to A; decodes output z.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output asserted when FSM is in state E or F.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: State register, w-driven next-state logic and E/F output decode.
